description: OpenAI-style tool definitions for eacli (shell agents without MCP)

function.name: list_members
function.description: List bookable household members. **Response shape (v1.5+):** when multiple profiles exist in .eacli-profiles.json, returns `data.profiles` (array of { key, name, hasSession, default }) without logging in. Single-account .env setups still return `data.members` (portal linked members). Household members need separate EA logins in .eacli-profiles.json — pass member or profile to select whose account to use. The portal member switcher no longer works. Call this first when the user says "me" or "book for me" and multiple people may exist.

function.name: list_bookings
function.description: List upcoming bookings for the active profile only (one EA login). Household members need separate EA logins in .eacli-profiles.json — pass member or profile to select whose account to use. The portal member switcher no longer works. Pass member or profile to switch. Each booking has a members array and status "Confirmed" or "Waiting List".

function.name: list_favourites
function.description: List QuickBook favourite activities for the active profile. Household members need separate EA logins in .eacli-profiles.json — pass member or profile to select whose account to use. The portal member switcher no longer works.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check bookable or waitlist slots for in-centre Group Exercise 16+ Yrs classes. Always pass activity and date. Dates accept saturday, next sunday, today, 2026-05-25, or 25/05/2026. Prefer explicit DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD over natural language for edge-of-window classes. Household members need separate EA logins in .eacli-profiles.json — pass member or profile to select whose account to use. The portal member switcher no longer works. Response groups include alreadyBooked and bookable.

activity.description: Activity name (partial match). Prefer compact names: hiit, combat, bodycombat (not spaced portal labels like "h I I t"). Portal may display "H I I T Sat 08:25" — either form works, but omit day/time unless matching a full label. In-centre classes use Group Exercise 16+ Yrs: "combat" Sunday → BodyCombat Sun, Thursday → Combat Thu. Virtual classes are prefixed "Vir".

date.description: Session date: natural language (saturday, next sunday, today) or ISO (2026-05-25) or UK (25/05/2026). Prefer explicit DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD for reliability and edge-of-window classes.

function.name: book_class
function.description: Book an in-centre Group Exercise class for the active profile. Dates accept saturday, next sunday, today, 2026-05-25, or 25/05/2026. Prefer explicit DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD over natural language for edge-of-window classes. Household members need separate EA logins in .eacli-profiles.json — pass member or profile to select whose account to use. The portal member switcher no longer works. Requires user confirmation after check_availability. Pass member or profile explicitly when multiple household members exist. Returns ALREADY_BOOKED when appropriate.

function.name: login
function.description: Force login to Everyone Active for a profile. Household members need separate EA logins in .eacli-profiles.json — pass member or profile to select whose account to use. The portal member switcher no longer works. Run once per profile after setup. Uses credentials from .eacli-profiles.json or .env (default profile).

function.name: doctor
function.description: Check local setup: profiles or .env credentials, per-profile session files, Playwright install. No browser login.
